subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Mental maths (number range 5)
source.subtopic: Compare numbers to 5 and say which is more or less; one more, one less, two more, two less (weeks 5-10)

show.line: Three bananas. One more makes four. One less makes two. Let's play more and less!

rounds.prompt: One more than two. Tap the number.
rounds.praise: One more than two is three.

rounds.prompt: One less than five. Tap the number.
rounds.praise: One less than five is four.

rounds.prompt: Four cars. One more car comes. How many now? Say the number.
Which is more, three or five?
Two more than one. Tap the number.
rounds.praise: Two more than one is three.

rounds.prompt: One less each time. Five, four, three, and then?
Which number is less, two or four?

hints: One more means count one forward. One less means count one back.
Find the number on the line. More is to the right.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! One less than four.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One less than four is five!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! One less than four is three.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count back together. Four, and one less is three!

parent_line: Can say one more and one less than a number up to 5 and compare numbers.
